vocabulary.definition: Version 6 of the Internet Protocol, using 128-bit addresses and IPv6-specific neighbor discovery.
IPv6 uses a Hop Limit field that is decremented by each forwarding node and causes the packet to be discarded when it reaches zero.
TCP defines orderly connection closing using FIN signaling and state transitions so each direction of the byte stream can be closed.
TCP identifies application endpoints with port numbers in addition to IP addresses, allowing multiple conversations to share a host.
IPv6 Neighbor Discovery lets hosts discover routers on attached links using ICMPv6 Router Solicitation and Router Advertisement messages.
IPv6 Neighbor Discovery includes Duplicate Address Detection to help determine whether an address is already in use on a link.
